headline: CHINA CUTS RARE EARTH SHIPMENTS TO US — USAR Completes $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Same Week; Western Scaled Heavy REE Supply Now Live
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) completed its $2.8B acquisition of Serra Verde — the only scaled non-Asian producer of all four magnetic rare earth elements — on Sept. 3, the same week Chinese suppliers began refusing to ship rare earth materials to U.S. customers. The timing sent USAR up 4%, then gave most gains back. A September 24 Xi-Washington summit could shift export licensing language in real time.

headline: GOLD NEAR $4,500 AS WALLER SIGNALS FED HOLD — Rate-Hike Odds Fall From 66% To 50%; Today's NFP Report The Next Trigger
snippet: Fed Governor Waller said Thursday he would support holding rates steady at the Sept. 15-16 meeting if upcoming data confirm disinflation continues, cutting rate-hike odds from 66% to 50% and lifting gold back above $4,450 after a three-session slide to $4,326. Friday's non-farm payrolls report is the decisive input: a soft print could push bullion through $4,500; a hot number retests $4,300.

headline: GOLDMAN SACHS SLASHES GOLD TARGET TO $4,900 — Down $500 From Prior $5,400 Estimate; First Fed Rate Cut Pushed To March 2027
snippet: Goldman Sachs Research cut its year-end gold price forecast from $5,400 to $4,900/oz, citing a delayed Fed rate-cut timeline now pushed to March 2027. The bank also flagged that investors are increasingly using gold options to hedge against large-scale policy risk, adding structural volatility to bullion even at record price levels.

headline: CENTRAL BANK GOLD BUYING HALVES IN JULY — 23 Tonnes vs 51 In June; WGC Says Investment Demand Is Now The Market's Primary Driver
snippet: Net official-sector gold purchases fell 54% month-on-month to 23 tonnes in July, World Gold Council data shows, even as bullion held near record highs. China added 20 tonnes, Poland 8 tonnes; Russia sold 6 tonnes. The WGC says private investment demand has replaced central banks as the principal engine of the gold bull market through the remainder of 2026.

headline: CHILE COPPER OUTPUT HITS 19-YEAR Q2 LOW — Cochilco Cuts 2026 Forecast To 5.27Mt; Ore Grade Decline + Winter Storms Choke Codelco And Escondida
snippet: Chile's Q2 2026 copper production contracted 7.7% year-on-year — the weakest second quarter in 19 years — prompting Cochilco to cut its annual forecast to 5.27 million tonnes, a 2.6% full-year decline. Structural ore-grade deterioration at Codelco and BHP Escondida, compounded by severe winter storms, are the primary drivers and add structural weight to the LME copper squeeze already underway.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER HITS 49.2m AT 4.7% CuEq AT PALMER VMS — Incl. 27m At 8.4%; Drill Program Expanded To 12,250m On High-Grade Core; TSX-V: VCU
snippet: Vizsla Copper (TSX-V: VCU) reported 49.2 metres grading 4.7% copper equivalent — including a 27-metre high-grade core at 8.4% CuEq (5.46% Cu, 8.55% Zn, 39 g/t Ag) — from its 2026 program at the Palmer VMS deposit in southeast Alaska. Results confirm continuity of South Wall Zone 1 and extend the system downdip, prompting management to expand the program from 10,000 to 12,250 metres.

headline: ZAMBIA'S $1.8B IN GOLD DISAPPEARS INTO INFORMAL TRADE — UAE Declares $1.8Bn In Imports vs Zambia's $128M In Exports; ZCCM-IH Bets On Ghana Model
snippet: ZCCM Investments Holdings plans to formalise Zambia's artisanal and small-scale gold sector using Ghana's state gold-board model, aiming to capture $1.8 billion in output currently flowing through informal export channels. A stark trade-data gap confirms the scale: the UAE alone declared $1.8 billion in Zambian gold imports in 2023, while Zambia's own statistics showed just $128 million in exports.

headline: FREEPORT INDONESIA CONFIRMS MANYAR COPPER SMELTER RESTART — World's Largest Single-Line Facility Back Online; 65% Utilisation Targeted By Year-End
snippet: PT Freeport Indonesia confirmed the Manyar smelter — the world's largest single-line copper processing facility — has resumed operations after a fire-related shutdown, with a phased ramp targeting 65% utilisation by end-2026 and full capacity by late 2027. Grasberg mine concentrate is feeding the restart, adding meaningful processing capacity back to global copper supply chains.

headline: DYNASTY GOLD DRILLS FOR OPEN-PIT GOLD AT THUNDERCLOUD — 10-Hole, 2,400m Metallurgical Program; South Pelham Extension The Target; TSX-V: DYG
snippet: Dynasty Gold Corp. (TSX-V: DYG) commenced a 10-hole, 2,400-metre metallurgical drill program at the Thundercloud property in Ontario, targeting open-pit-accessible extensions of the South Pelham gold deposit and down-plunge continuations of the Pelham zone. The program will generate representative ore samples for processing studies required ahead of any development decision.

headline: FED UNCERTAINTY HOLDS GOLD HOSTAGE THIS WEEK — Soft CPI Unlocks $4,500 Breakout; Hot Print Retests $4,300; Mining Equity Beta Exposed Either Way
snippet: FXStreet's weekly gold outlook flags US inflation data as the decisive input for the next leg of the precious metals move: a soft CPI reading would dissolve remaining September rate-hike bets and drive XAU/USD through $4,500, while another inflation surprise would reset gold to the $4,300 level tested twice this week — dragging leveraged mining equities sharply in either direction.
